en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverbank where several wooden rowboats are drawn up on a rocky shore. People in long coats and head coverings are boarding or unloading the boats. Across the calm river a low, forested landscape is visible under a cloudy sky. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge in a Scandinavian language, with a photographer or studio credit at the lower right.
